summary_en: Chugoku Electric will tender 6.3 million shares (33.4% reduction) of Chuden Kogyo in a public tender offer at 4,614 yen per share, with an expected proceeds of 29.1 billion yen. Post-tender ownership will decline to 33.4% from 41.3%, while the company will retain continued ownership to maintain cooperation with the subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Tender for Chuden Kogyo's Self-Owned Shares and Anticipated Recording of Extraordinary Gain
translation_en_brief:
Chugoku Electric announced on October 30, 2026, that it will participate in a public tender offer initiated by its subsidiary Chuden Kogyo, tendering 6.3 million shares representing a reduction from 41.3% to 33.4% ownership. The tender offer price is set at 4,614 yen per share, generating expected proceeds of approximately 29.1 billion yen (or 28.068 billion yen based on stated amount). The tender offer period runs from November 2 through December 1, 2026, with settlement commencing on December 23, 2026.

Chugoku Electric stated that optimizing its capital relationship with Chuden Kogyo will improve capital efficiency. The two companies maintain close operational linkages across emerging business domains including battery energy storage systems and data center services. The company emphasized that it will retain continued ownership of Chuden Kogyo shares following the tender offer to sustain cooperation and advance shared enterprise value under the "Chugoku Electric Group Management Vision 2040."

The company expects to record an extraordinary gain of approximately 28 billion yen in individual financial statements and 5 billion yen in consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, assuming all 6.3 million tendered shares are accepted. However, if applications from other shareholders exceed the subsidiary's target purchase volume, pro-rata allocation may result in partial non-acceptance of Chugoku Electric's tendered shares.
